task_type: production web performance optimization and release
requested_outcome: Find and implement the next highest-value safe performance improvements after the smart-cache release, publish them to the existing VII Site, and verify the exact production result.
authorization_boundary: Local code changes, tests, Git push and one verified deployment to the existing VII Site are authorized. Preserve domain, D1, secrets, supplier connections, schedules, content truth and current audience.

lesson_bundle.reason: A performance claim must be proven on the exact live release and across the affected public-route family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires measured before-and-after evidence, browser navigation, mobile coverage and live route regression checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: The change will be published to the existing VII production Site.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires one saved release, exact source identity, live URL verification and a preserved rollback version.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a targeted performance pass and must not redesign or remove approved behavior.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires an explicit invariant list and regression evidence for unchanged content, navigation, language and transactional semantics.

lesson_bundle.reason: Search is the largest remaining public payload and the user's most latency-sensitive discovery surface.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires measured search payload and interaction speed, accurate result-state preservation and no cache collision or stale-state regression.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The change reports a faster cache but leaves first-load JavaScript, hydration or image work unchanged.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Measure live resource transfer and runtime work first, then optimize the largest attributable bottleneck instead of repeating cache-only work.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Before-and-after live evidence names the reduced resource or deferred work and shows a measurable result.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The homepage improves while search, world pages or detail pages remain heavy.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory and test the homepage, search, hourly, events, spa and representative detail routes.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The affected family returns 200 and the changed shared path is verified on every representative route.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Optimization removes content, breaks SEO, changes language navigation or serves stale personal and booking state.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve server HTML, metadata, localized routes and strict cache exclusions for private, transactional and RSC requests.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Raw HTML, canonical and language routes remain valid; excluded requests receive no public-cache marker.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A local improvement is published without proving the actual production click path and mobile result.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Exercise the exact deployed site in a browser on desktop and 390-pixel mobile after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Real browser navigation, progressive search and overflow checks pass on the deployed URL.

affected_family: public homepage and localized home routes
general search and progressive result rendering
hourly, events and spa index routes
shared header navigation and route prefetch
JavaScript, CSS, fonts and optimized image delivery
anonymous document and catalog cache behavior
authenticated, private, transactional and RSC exclusions

sources.label: VII approved architecture and performance direction
VII accepted product behavior and family consistency

midpoint_gate.trigger: After measuring the production resource waterfall and implementing the first high-value optimization locally, before broadening or deploying.
checks: The targeted bottleneck is supported by measured live evidence.
The local production build passes and the changed route retains its content and interaction contract.
The improvement is not merely a duplicate of the already-published cache work.

attack_questions: Does a cold anonymous visit still download or execute the same heavy resources before useful content?
Did any deferred or split component become blank, shift layout or fail after interaction?
Do private, authenticated, booking and RSC requests still bypass shared public cache?
Does the exact live release preserve localized logo navigation, result progression, SEO metadata and mobile geometry?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact deployed URL, saved release identity, live resource and timing measurements, and real browser interaction evidence.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Representative public routes, both directions, private exclusions, search states, desktop and 390-pixel mobile all pass after deployment.

effectiveness.baseline: The prior live release reduced search HTML to about 1.18 MB and warm public TTFB to about 0.30-0.66 seconds, but client resource and hydration costs remain to be measured and improved.
effectiveness.target: Deliver another independently measurable production performance gain without regression or unsafe cache expansion.
